findings.F1: Step 5's own result points the other way from the idea. Over 5 days the short-side unusual move is -1.72 % per case (t -0.93, 66 cases on 42 days), which means the coin rose. My recount of pierce-and-reclaim days inside the falling agitated profile in folds B and C agrees: the long-side unusual move is +3.9 % over 5 days (t 1.29, 30 cases, 15 days) and +6.6 % over 10 days (t 1.35, 27 cases).
findings.F2: Inside the profile the depth grading has the shape the idea predicts but sits on the rebound side, so there is no clear fall to amend toward. Over 5 days, shallow pierces rise +11.9 % (t 1.76, 9 cases), mid pierces rise +3.7 % (t 1.52), and deep pierces fall only -1.3 % (t -0.55, 12 cases); the Spearman correlation between depth and the 5-day move is -0.33.
findings.F3: The continuation the idea describes appears outside the falling agitated profile. Pierce-and-reclaim days there are followed by an unusual move of -4.1 % over 5 days (t -1.98, 113 cases, 75 days) and -5.8 % over 10 days (t -2.89, 93 cases, 62 days). Ordinary days in the profile drift +0.7 % over 5 days (t 0.52).

ideas.idea: In a rising market, when a coin's day trades below its lowest price of the past 30 days but closes back above that low, it falls over the next 10 days, and the fall is larger the deeper the day's low went below the 30-day low.
ideas.consequence: After a reclaimed monthly-low pierce in an uptrend, a trader should expect the uptrend to break further down rather than resume, and so refuse longs or lean short, harder the deeper the probe was.
ideas.name: rising-market reclaimed-low continuation

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, when a coin's day trades below its lowest price of the past 30 days but closes back above that low, it falls over the next 10 days, and the fall is larger the deeper the day's low went below the 30-day low.
ideas.consequence: In a sideways market, a reclaimed pierce of the monthly low is the start of a breakdown rather than a failed break, so a trader should lean short over the following ten days, more so the deeper the probe.
ideas.name: choppy-market reclaimed-low continuation
